sections.title: Item 1. Business
sections.content:
ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, and sells a variety of related services. Products include iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Wearables, Home and Accessories. Services include Advertising, AppleCare, Cloud Services, Digital Content, and Payment Services.

sections.title: Item 1A. Risk Factors
sections.content:
ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS

Global economic conditions, geopolitical conflicts, and trade disputes could adversely affect the Company's business. In particular, substantially all of the Company's manufacturing is performed by outsourced partners located primarily in Asia, including mainland China, India, and Vietnam. Any disruption at these manufacturing facilities could severely limit supply.

sections.title: Item 7. MD&A
sections.content:
ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

Total net sales decreased 3% or $11.0 billion during 2023 compared to 2022. Products net sales decreased due to lower sales of Mac and iPad. Services net sales increased 9% driven by growth in advertising, App Store, and cloud services.

Research and development expense was $29,915 million in 2023, compared to $26,251 million in 2022, representing an increase of 14% to support next-generation silicon, AI technologies, and visionOS platform development.

sections.title: Item 8. Financial Statements
sections.content:

| Services | $ 85,200 | $ 78,129 | $ 68,425 |
| Total net sales | $ 383,285 | $ 394,328 | $ 365,817 |
| Total cost of sales | $ 214,137 | $ 223,546 | $ 212,981 |
| Gross margin | $ 169,148 | $ 170,782 | $ 152,836 |
| Operating income | $ 114,301 | $ 119,437 | $ 108,949 |
